navigation.deleteEmptyGroupHelp: This group is empty. Confirm to remove it from the group bar.
navigation.deleteGroupContentsHelp: There is no other eligible group for these contents. Continuing deletes this group and all of its sites and folders.
navigation.groupContentsChanged: The contents of the group changed. Review the group and confirm deletion again.
navigation.noWritableGroups: Create an available group on the home page first.
navigation.groupPrivacyHelp: Hiding controls tab visibility. Encryption protects group contents, and group names remain available for the tab labels. Triple-click the first visible, unencrypted tab to show or hide hidden groups.
navigation.sharedGroupPasswordHelp: All encrypted groups share this password. Use at least six characters.
navigation.encryptedGroupConflict: This import or sync contains an unencrypted copy of an encrypted group. Your data was not changed.
navigation.legacyGroupMigrationHelp: Enter your existing password to add the groups to the shared tab bar. Their names are available as tab labels and their contents stay encrypted.
navigation.invalidIcon: Choose a valid icon and background color
navigation.invalidUrl: Enter an http or https URL without embedded credentials
navigation.cropHelp: Drag the image or use arrow keys to move it, then zoom to remove unwanted edges.
navigation.cropRequired: Wait for the image to load and select a crop area
navigation.cropPreservesBackground: Cropping only removes content outside the selection; it keeps white and transparent backgrounds.
navigation.iconFetchFailed: Could not fetch the icon. Use a text icon or upload an image.
navigation.iconRefreshFailed: No high-resolution website icon was found. Your current image is kept. Retry or upload an image.
navigation.noImage: No image is available. Upload an icon.
navigation.name: Name
navigation.websiteIconHelp: Fetched automatically after entering a URL, then saved locally.
navigation.draftIconHelp: Icon fetched. Save it to make it available offline.
navigation.privateIconHelp: Fetch an icon to save it in the private space.
navigation.uploadIconHelp: PNG, JPG, WebP, SVG and ICO supported
navigation.textIconHelp: Use text and a background color as the icon.
navigation.changedSiteIconFailed: The URL has changed, but the new site icon could not be fetched. Retry, choose a text icon, or upload an image before saving.
